default_body.markdown: ## Updates:- GP#2188: Added an SFPEW compatibility layer switch for MobileGlues (by @MovTery)## Changes:- GP#2188: Adjusted the position of the reset button in the renderer config dialog (by @MovTery)## Fixes:- GP#2188: Fixed MobileGlues config display not matching what actually takes effect (by @MovTery)- GP#2187: Physical mouse button clicks not working on some devices (by @mvanhorn)- GP#2194: Flaw in the modpack export filtering mechanism, resulting in possibly incomplete exported files (by @MovTery)- GP#2195: Incorrect list height on the Java management screen, causing abnormal background rendering (by @MovTery)- GP#2199: Crash on Android 8.x due to text being created and copied off the main thread (by @MovTery)- GP#2204: Actively sync SDL gamepad device enumeration, fixing Controlify requiring a gamepad reconnect before passthrough works (by @MovTery)- GP#2205: Local cache of server icons never updates (by @MovTery)- GP#2206: The disabled state of the original file is now preserved when updating mods (by @MovTery)

bodies.markdown: ## 更新发布页- B站：https://www.bilibili.com/read/readlist/rl1103422- 爱发电：https://ifdian.net/album/40422970d64c11f1a1cd5254001e7c00- Github：https://github.com/ZalithLauncher/ZalithLauncher2/releases## 更新：- GP#2188：为 MobileGlues 新增 SFPEW 兼容层开关 (by @MovTery)## 调整：- GP#2188：调整渲染器配置对话框内重置按钮的位置 (by @MovTery)## 修复：- GP#2188：修复 MobileGlues 配置显示与生效不符 (by @MovTery)- GP#2187：修复部分设备实体鼠标按键点击无效的问题 (by @mvanhorn)- GP#2194：导出整合包的过滤机制缺陷，导致导出文件可能不完整 (by @MovTery)- GP#2195：Java 管理屏幕列表高度不正确，导致背景画面异常 (by @MovTery)- GP#2199：Android 8.x 未在主线程创建并复制文本导致崩溃 (by @MovTery)- GP#2204：主动同步 SDL 手柄设备枚举，修复 Controlify 需重连手柄才能直通 (by @MovTery)- GP#2205：服务器图标的本地缓存始终无法更新 (by @MovTery)- GP#2206：更新模组时保持原文件的禁用状态 (by @MovTery)
